title: An undo press that proves nothing (the host answered 202) still tells the agent but no longer marks the Site changes row undone or drops its Undo; a later proven press marks it and a later unproven press keeps an earlier proof
steps: S1: Run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/review-turn-store.test.mjs against TEST_DATABASE_URL (markTurnsUndone with marks from undoneMarks over runUndo answered 202 FLEET_JOB_PENDING, then 200 succeeded, then 202 again).
S2: Same file: an unproven press after a proven one, read back through turnUndoneOf.
expect: S1: the 202-only press stamps undone_at (the agent notice) and leaves undo_proven_at null, so turnUndoneOf reads null; the proven press after it reads {at, complete: true}.
S2: the later 202 press moves undone_at forward and turnUndoneOf reads the same {at, complete} as before it.
evidence: Before this change one stamp, site_turn.undone_at, served the agent notice (any press, even unsure) and the Site changes row (undone only by proof): a 202 press showed the row as Partly undone and removed its Undo with nothing proven gone (review 09/10/2026, kept as a todo FINDING test).
fence: undoneMarks marks each turn proven only when a moment is in undoneShas, a write reverted or a look undone; markTurnsUndone stamps undo_proven_at and undo_complete only for proven marks; turnUndoneOf reads undo_proven_at

tests: a press that undid nothing verifiably (host answered 202) tells the agent but does not mark the Site changes row undone
a proven press after an unproven one marks the row; an unproven press after a proven one keeps it
